FT lab-heavy instructors FT instructor-semesters where labs (code ending in “L”) dominate the load — current filters & university tab apply

Labs are lower-credit (typically 1 cr) and lighter prep than lectures, so an FT instructor whose entire load is labs may be under-contributing to compliance even if total credits look healthy. Bands: All labs 100% · Mostly labs ≥ threshold and below 100%. Click a row to see the section breakdown.

FT under-utilization FT instructor-semesters by teaching load — current filters & university tab apply

An FT instructor teaching well below the standard load may indicate compliance leakage — FT salary is paid but FT credit contribution is low. Bands: Compliant ≥ threshold · Light within 3 credits below · Severely light more than 3 below. Rows with blank or "TBA" instructors are excluded.

FT cost breakdown academic year

FT total includes base pay (Fall + Spring + Summer), schooling, insurance, and end-of-service accrual at 1/12 of annual base (one month per AY).

PT cost breakdown academic year

What 50/50 compliance would cost linear projection using current cost-per-credit

Projection holds the total credits taught constant and shifts the FT/PT split to 50/50 using today's cost-per-credit for each contract type. It does not model hiring overhead, salary bands by school, or step changes in benefits as FT headcount grows — treat as a directional estimate.
